_comment: WATER-GULL-SIGNAL-0909. Gull Rest is the optional sheltered Reedhaven branch and is authored as a stranded-researcher destination, but its named signal-spire row had no runtime consumer. This one weathered timber lookout uses the installed textured medieval wood family and the existing visible torch. It stands 18.57m from the landmark waypoint and 13.82m from the nearer adjacent route centreline, leaving 9.32m after the two-metre route half-width and conservative 2.5m visible footprint. The retained canonical camera at (-73.332,904.922), heading (0.141,-0.990), places the site centre 23.66m forward and 0.005m lateral; its full 2.5m radius lies inside the unchanged 70-degree/1280x800 frustum. The four rendered braces receive matching AABB collision; every brace foot samples terrain and stretches only upward to one level platform, so sloped terrain cannot leave floating pillars. No route, terrain, actor, encounter, pickup, dock, light preset or progression datum changes.
